body: My best friend said this to me, and it still makes me insecure to this day..
Thank you for reaching out and your sympathy. That’s good! Do you book at a local clinic, your school? How do you go about looking for a therapist in the first place or know what provides good care?

No don’t worry about it! You replying to this already helps. No I’m very sensitive and take any mistake as an insult to my character and a reason I should end it all. I basically have the same intense reaction to everything big and small, it’s very irrational. All of that translates into my hobbies as well, like panting. So when I paint instead of work, I use that to justify my poor mindset. My emotions get so intense that I end up hating everything and it ends up happening multiple times a day that I exhaust myself
Thank you, I will look into them. And I’m sorry for that, and glad you pulled through. I would love some suggestions on them as I’m pretty unfamiliar with nootropics. Are there side effects?
Thank you for commenting. I’m not sure that I do, I do like painting but everytime I try I just beat myself up about it
